project.name: Guitar Ear Training App
project.description: Phone-based ear training app for guitar players. Teaches chord families, naming conventions, and intervals using recorded guitar sounds. All-ages product, kid-friendly — Ruairidh (10) represents the youngest demanding user the app must serve, not the target audience. Designed for beginner-to-intermediate players practising in found time without an instrument in hand.

nextStep: Continue with Marcus on the next outcome. Strong candidate: Complete a Test on a known element — applies the Test-mode rules logged in Outcome 1 (binary = 1 attempt, 3+ = 2 attempts, timed, no pause, leaderboard impact) and the Test-continue behaviour flagged in Outcome 2. Other candidates: session-save outcome (produces the resume state both Outcome 1 and 2 depend on), profile-creation/onboarding outcome.

taxonomy.module: Large category — Intervals, Chords, Chord Sequences
taxonomy.element: Specific exercise within a module — e.g. Intervals > Major & Minor 2nds, Major & Minor 3rds, Melodic vs Harmonic. The question bank, Practice, Test, and best scores all live at the element level.
taxonomy.scoresLocation: Module page, per element. Never on the home screen.
taxonomy.openContentQuestion: How finely Intervals subdivides into elements, and whether ascending/descending/mixed and melodic/harmonic are separate elements or options within an element. Parked — content design, not blocking.
